document_title: Girish — Personal Knowledge Base Q&A Draft
sharing_note: All entries are set to public at the owner’s request. Entries marked as needing confirmation contain details that may need spelling, date, or relationship clarification.

entries.question: What name should I use for you?
entries.answer: My name is Girish. The exact English spelling of my full name has not been confirmed yet.

entries.question: Where were you born, and where did you grow up?
entries.answer: I was born in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, and moved to Hyderabad soon after I was born. I spent about nine years studying in Hyderabad before moving to Machilipatnam after fourth standard.

entries.question: Where did you study in Hyderabad?
entries.answer: I studied in Hyderabad through fourth standard at a campus in KPHB. I referred to the campus name as “Scotdale”; its correct English spelling still needs confirmation.

entries.question: Why did you move to Machilipatnam?
entries.answer: After fourth standard, I had to move to Machilipatnam because of some personal circumstances. I continued my studies while staying near my maternal grandmother’s home.

entries.question: Which schools did you attend in Machilipatnam?
entries.answer: I studied at Balaji Vidyalayam from fifth through eighth standard. I later moved to Sri Chaitanya School for tenth standard. I have not yet specified where I studied in ninth standard.

entries.question: Where did you complete Intermediate?
entries.answer: I completed Intermediate at Sri Chaitanya Junior College.

entries.question: How did you get into engineering?
entries.answer: After Intermediate, I took the EAMCET entrance exam, earned a rank, and secured an engineering seat. I have not yet shared my rank or the year I took the exam.

entries.question: What did you study for your BTech degree?
entries.answer: I completed a BTech in Electronics and Communication Engineering at NRI Institute of Technology. I had originally planned to study Computer Science, but I joined Electronics and Communication Engineering instead.

entries.question: What was your final BTech score?
entries.answer: I completed my BTech with a score of 6.5. I have not yet confirmed whether this refers to my CGPA or another scoring measure.

entries.question: How would you describe your technical background?
entries.answer: I describe my background as fully technical, with experience across IT, software development, and cloud architecture. I have not yet listed the specific technologies, projects, or proficiency levels that support this description.

entries.question: Where are you based now?
entries.answer: I am based in Hyderabad and sometimes travel to Machilipatnam, where members of my family live.

entries.question: What personal story from your college years did you share?
entries.answer: During my BTech years, I had strong feelings for someone and used the nickname “Mandy Salena Celina” for her. I told her how I felt on September 4, but she did not feel the same way. I have not specified the year.

entries.question: What does the nickname “Mandy Salena Celina” mean?
entries.answer: I said the nickname has a meaning, but I have not shared the meaning yet.

entries.question: Which family members live in Machilipatnam and Hyderabad?
entries.answer: I mentioned that some family members live in Machilipatnam and that I stay with family in Hyderabad. I have not yet clarified the exact relationships or living arrangements.

entries.question: When did you complete school and Intermediate?
entries.answer: I completed school in 2018 and Intermediate at Sri Chaitanya Junior College from 2018 to 2020.

entries.question: When did you begin and complete your BTech?
entries.answer: The COVID-19 pandemic affected my plans, so I joined BTech in 2021. I studied Electronics and Communication Engineering at NRI Institute of Technology from 2021 to 2024.

entries.question: Where did you start your IT career?
entries.answer: Around late 2024 or early 2025, I joined Datavalley as an intern at a company I described as a U-Tech company. The exact company name and spelling need confirmation.

entries.question: Was your internship paid, and how long did it last?
entries.answer: My internship was unpaid, and I worked there for six months.

entries.question: What happened after your internship?
entries.answer: After about six months, I was selected for a next opportunity and continued moving forward in my career. The exact role, employer, and transition details are not yet clear.

entries.question: What kind of work do you do now?
entries.answer: I currently work at an IT startup. I see this job as enough to cover my expenses. I have not yet shared my job title or the company name.

entries.question: How would you describe your love life?
entries.answer: I have experienced one-sided love. I have chosen not to reveal the person’s real name and refer to her by the nickname “Mandy Salena Celina.”

entries.question: What have you decided about marriage?
entries.answer: I have decided that if the person I love marries someone else, I will not get married. This is a personal decision I shared about my one-sided love.

entries.question: How would you describe your social personality?
entries.answer: I am an introvert. I feel nervous talking with women and can feel anxious in large groups.

entries.question: What have you shared about your sexual experience?
entries.answer: I have not had sexual experience; I describe myself as a virgin.

entries.question: Do you have siblings?
entries.answer: I have three older sisters—Teja Veeran, Shalini Veeran, and Barvi Veeran—and one older brother, Neeraj Veeran. The English spellings of their names are based on my pronunciation and may need confirmation.

entries.question: Where do your siblings live?
entries.answer: My sisters and brother are settled abroad. I am the only one among my siblings currently living in India.

entries.question: Do you have other close family members?
entries.answer: I have relatives on both my mother’s and father’s sides, and I meet them from time to time. I also mentioned two younger male relatives on my mother’s side, Manoj and Sandeep, whom I want to look after. Their exact relationship to me needs clarification.

entries.question: What does a typical day look like for you?
entries.answer: I usually wake up in the morning, get ready, and go to the office. I return around 7 p.m., take care of my work and daily needs, and then go to sleep. Most days follow a similar routine.

entries.question: What kind of travel do you enjoy?
entries.answer: I love travelling, especially trips abroad, and I hope to travel internationally.

entries.question: What are you passionate about?
entries.answer: I love technology. I keep up with new releases and take time to check out and learn about new technology.
